concepts.label: Culture, interpretation and public life
concepts.concept: Combine historical, literary, visual and philosophical inquiry to understand identity, representation and contemporary social problems, using actual cultural sources and qualitative research.

concepts.label: Digital heritage, media and cultural memory
concepts.concept: Study how media technologies and institutions shape cultural memory and identity, combining historical/visual interpretation, archives and documentary storytelling with critical digital and database literacy.

concepts.label: Culture, health and lived experience
concepts.concept: Investigate how cultural narratives, historical categories and social relations shape illness, stigma and lived experience, with philosophical interpretation and psychological/public-health evidence as specific complementary methods.
